positions.description:
Embedded Systems Architect

Focus on High Volume, Low-Cost ARM Cortex M0/M3/M4 system design and implementation and system bring-up.   Design of bare-metal and rtos systems.

Benchmark and analyze MCU implementations, compilers and other debugging tools for migrating product lines to next generation toolset.

positions.title: Chief
positions.description:
Chief for the Auxiliary Communications Service of the San Francisco Department of Emergency Management.   We are a volunteer organization with a mission to serve the City of San Francisco and it's people in times of Emergency.   We provide backup communications to various city agencies including Police, Fire, Health, Pubic Works, State and Federal agencies wherever and whenever needed.

I manage a staff of section leaders and head the organization.   I am also responsible for oversight, guidance and act as a liaison to various city officials.

Note: Although I have been involved in this organization since 1996,  I was assigned the role of Chief in January, 2010.

company.name: San Francisco Department of Emergency Services Auxilliary Communications Service (ACS)

positions.title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
positions.description:
We are a low-volume, high-cost embedded system product manufacturer.   We design and manufacture high-quality laboratory and aerospace equipment entirely in-house in our engineering/manufacturing facility in downtown San Francisco, California.   I take a lot of pride in our 'Made in the USA' philosophy!

Responsible for design of realtime embedded systems.
Some digital circuit design and PCB layout (when necessary, not my primary role!).

Some of my designs involve Embedded Linux, PCI device drivers, FreeRtos, Various embedded TCP/IP stack implementations, network device driver creation.

This also involves conceptual designs created from customer requirements, hands-on development of designs involving AVR and ARM microprocessors using JTAG tools, logic analyzers and oscilloscopes, test and Q&A and integrating these products into our production cycle.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Develop prototype hardware security modules using RTOS
Develop secure MP3 player for inmates using bare-metal system

positions.title: Engineering Manager, MTS Hardware Integration Team
positions.description:
Manage 45 engineers developing Board Support Packages, device drivers and architecture ports for the VxWorks operating system.

Manage the integration of over 90 acquired technology teams into a scalable platform and develop standards for future platforms including documentation, QA and testing methodologies.

Interface with major MCU silicon vendors such as Intel, FreeScale and Hitachi to decide which future architectures will be supported by the VxWorks/Tornado development environment.

positions.title: RTOS Consultant
positions.description:
Develop and debug MIPS-based board support package using VxWorks RTOS
Analyze critical system errors
Make recommendations to improve reliability and improve systems performance

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Develop custom RTOS device driver interfaces between JTAG, NetRom and other embedded debugging tools.

positions.description:

for bedside medical devices
